tasks.final_text: Today I attended a team activity to choose something to paint and then to paint it. My whole team attended except for one person, and the results were really great. We even were able to include some of our alumni at the event, and a visiting guest from Utah. Overall it was a tremendous success.

The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the nation museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.
